verdict.rationale: Vonage Video API is a developer platform that mentions a low-code/no-code offering, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents automation versioning, review, or rollback. Webhooks, archiving, and session configuration are adjacent features and are not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
